+"""Driver for the limited-mode sit_simple robot episode."""
+import time
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+
+RANGES = np.array([
+    [-.43, .43], [-.43, .43], [-3.14, 2.53], [-.26, 2.05], [-.87, .52],
+    [-.43, .43], [-.43, .43], [-3.14, 2.53], [-.26, 2.05], [-.87, .52],

+    [-2.87, 2.87], [-3.11, .34], [-4.45, 1.3], [-1.25, 2.61],
+])
+
+
+def action_for(q):
+    return np.clip(2 * (np.asarray(q) - RANGES[:, 0]) / (RANGES[:, 1] - RANGES[:, 0]) - 1, -1, 1)
+
+
+def hold_transition(robot, start, target, steps, images=False):
+    """Smoothly interpolate joint targets over a fixed number of control ticks."""
+    rows = np.stack([action_for(start + (target - start) * (i + 1) / steps)
+                     for i in range(steps)])
+    return robot.step("qpos", rows, images=images)
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()

+
